# Flywheel Docs

- [Flywheel Docs](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc): Documentation for installing Flywheel, using MCP, and working with research graphs.
- [Install](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/install): Install, update, and uninstall the Flywheel CLI.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/quickstart): Create the first Flywheel local setup and inspect the product surfaces.
- [Flywheel Tutorial](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/tutorial): Learn how to install Flywheel, connect MCP hosts, use the Web UI, and work with research graphs.
- [API Reference](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/api): Public Flywheel HTTP API reference generated from the sanitized OpenAPI schema.
- [Campaigns](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/concepts/campaigns): Understand campaign roots, submission artifacts, and visibility policy.
- [Graph Model](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/concepts/graph-model): Flywheel represents research work as a directed graph of durable nodes.
- [Hooks And Automations](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/concepts/hooks): Configure event-driven node automations that react to Flywheel artifacts.
- [Nodes, Artifacts, And Executions](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/concepts/nodes-artifacts-executions): The core durable records exposed by Flywheel.
- [Usage Limits](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/concepts/usage-limits): Per-user Flywheel write limits and how to handle rate-limit responses.
- [account:detach](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/account-detach): Detach a linked alias account (requires confirm="DETACH"). Requires a browser session; API-key callers receive session_auth_required with /app?settings=user.
- [account:emails:add](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/account-emails-add): Add an email alias to your account. Requires a browser session; API-key callers receive session_auth_required with /app?settings=user.
- [account:emails:remove](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/account-emails-remove): Remove an email alias from your account. Requires a browser session; API-key callers receive session_auth_required with /app?settings=user.
- [account:emails:set-primary](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/account-emails-set-primary): Set your primary email address. Requires a browser session; API-key callers receive session_auth_required with /app?settings=user.
- [account:get](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/account-get): View account snapshot and linked identities.
- [account:merge:preview](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/account-merge-preview): Preview what an account merge will do. Requires a browser session; API-key callers receive session_auth_required with /app?settings=user.
- [account:merge:proof](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/account-merge-proof): Mint a merge proof token from a source session token. Requires a browser session; API-key callers receive session_auth_required with /app?settings=user.
- [account:merge](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/account-merge): Execute an account merge (requires confirm="MERGE"). Requires a browser session; API-key callers receive session_auth_required with /app?settings=user.
- [api-keys:create](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/api-keys-create): Create a new API key and return the raw material once.
- [api-keys:delete](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/api-keys-delete): Delete an API key (refuses to delete the active one unless --allow-self).
- [api-keys:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/api-keys-list): List your API keys.
- [api-keys:rotate](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/api-keys-rotate): Rotate an API key (refuses to rotate the active one unless --allow-self).
- [approval-sessions:expire](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/approval-sessions-expire): Expire an approval session.
- [approval-sessions:heartbeat](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/approval-sessions-heartbeat): Create or refresh a compute approval session.
- [approval-sessions:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/approval-sessions-list): List approval sessions.
- [artifacts:delete-bulk](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/artifacts-delete-bulk): Delete multiple artifacts from one node.
- [artifacts:delete](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/artifacts-delete): Delete an artifact from a node.
- [artifacts:get](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/artifacts-get): Fetch one artifact metadata record.
- [artifacts:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/artifacts-list): List artifacts for a node.
- [artifacts:note:set](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/artifacts-note-set): Add, update, or clear an artifact note.
- [artifacts:upload:finalize](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/artifacts-upload-finalize): Finalize prepared artifact uploads and attach artifacts.
- [artifacts:upload:prepare](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/artifacts-upload-prepare): Create upload batch with signed per-item upload tickets.
- [artifacts:upload](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/artifacts-upload): One-shot upload: prepare + PUT + finalize from a single invocation.
- [auth:keychain:clear](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/auth-keychain-clear): Remove an API key from the OS keychain for a profile.
- [auth:keychain:set](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/auth-keychain-set): Store an API key in the OS keychain for a profile. Reads the key from stdin.
- [auth:login](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/auth-login): Bootstrap API key auth through RFC 8628 device authorization flow.
- [auth:status](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/auth-status): Show authentication status for the current client context.
- [blobs:get](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/blobs-get): Download a raw blob by storage key.
- [campaign-budgets:create](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/campaign-budgets-create): Create a campaign compute budget grant.
- [campaign-budgets:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/campaign-budgets-list): List campaign compute budgets for a root.
- [campaign-budgets:revoke](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/campaign-budgets-revoke): Revoke a campaign budget grant.
- [campaign-budgets:update](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/campaign-budgets-update): Update a campaign budget.
- [campaign:snapshot](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/campaign-snapshot): Resolve campaign root snapshot for a node.
- [completion bash](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/completion-bash): Generate a bash shell completion script
- [completion fish](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/completion-fish): Generate a fish shell completion script
- [completion install](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/completion-install): Install a generated shell completion script to a user-level location
- [completion nu](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/completion-nu): Generate a nu shell completion script
- [completion nushell](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/completion-nushell): Generate a nushell shell completion script
- [completion powershell](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/completion-powershell): Generate a powershell shell completion script
- [completion uninstall](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/completion-uninstall): Remove Flywheel-managed shell completion files and profile blocks
- [completion zsh](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/completion-zsh): Generate a zsh shell completion script
- [completion](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/completion): Generate a shell completion script from the public Flywheel Usage spec
- [compute:acquire](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/compute-acquire): Acquire managed compute for a node; with --wait, wait for usable SSH connection material.
- [compute:budgets](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/compute-budgets): List budget grants visible for a node context.
- [compute:connection](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/compute-connection): Get SSH connection material for a usable lease.
- [compute:funding](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/compute-funding): Read grant-scoped funding context before compute acquire.
- [compute-grants:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/compute-grants-list): List compute grants available to the user.
- [compute-grants:request-approval](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/compute-grants-request-approval): Request compute-grant approval. POSTs to the consolidated server endpoint which owns the heartbeat/grants/credits/campaign-budgets/status fan-out.
- [compute:options](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/compute-options): List allowed compute catalog options for a node.
- [compute:release-all](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/compute-release-all): Release all active leases in current scope (pass --force for account scope).
- [compute:release](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/compute-release): Release one active compute lease (async; use --wait to block).
- [compute:status](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/compute-status): Return compute lease status.
- [credits:balance](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/credits-balance): View credit balance and totals.
- [credits:billing-portal](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/credits-billing-portal): Open the Stripe billing portal for the current user and return browser_flow_required JSON with url, opened, and next_action.
- [credits:purchase](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/credits-purchase): Create a Stripe checkout session for a one-time purchase and return browser_flow_required JSON with url, opened, and next_action.
- [credits:referral:claim](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/credits-referral-claim): Claim referral rewards using a code.
- [credits:referral](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/credits-referral): View your referral code and status.
- [credits:subscribe](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/credits-subscribe): Create a Stripe checkout session for a subscription and return browser_flow_required JSON with url, opened, and next_action.
- [credits:subscription](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/credits-subscription): View your subscription status.
- [credits:transactions](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/credits-transactions): View paginated credit transactions.
- [credits:usage](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/credits-usage): Feature-based usage breakdown over a window.
- [executions:launch](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/executions-launch): Start an execution for a node.
- [executions:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/executions-list): List executions for a node.
- [executions:terminate](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/executions-terminate): Stop an execution for a node.
- [export:history](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/export-history): Export node history as JSONL.
- [export:subgraph](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/export-subgraph): Export a subgraph snapshot.
- [export:summary:pdf](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/export-summary-pdf): Render summary as PDF; requires --out.
- [export:summary:render-pdf](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/export-summary-render-pdf): Render caller-provided markdown as PDF; requires --out.
- [export:summary:stream](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/export-summary-stream): Stream summary generation as NDJSON events.
- [export:summary](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/export-summary): Generate a markdown summary export.
- [feedback:create](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/feedback-create): Submit bounded feedback to the Flywheel team.
- [files:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/files-list): List all your files across nodes.
- [github:disconnect](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/github-disconnect): Disconnect GitHub from your account.
- [github:link](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/github-link): Start the GitHub App install/link browser flow.
- [github:refresh-repos](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/github-refresh-repos): Refresh the list of accessible repositories.
- [github:status](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/github-status): Check GitHub connection status.
- [graph:get](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/graph-get): Read the graph projection for navigation and topology workflows.
- [help](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/help): Show Flywheel CLI help.
- [hooks:create](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/hooks-create): Create a new hook on an owner node.
- [hooks:delete](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/hooks-delete): Delete a hook from an owner node.
- [hooks:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/hooks-list): List hooks configured for an owner node.
- [hooks:runs:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/hooks-runs-list): List hook runs for an owner node.
- [hooks:secrets:create](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/hooks-secrets-create): Create a hook secret.
- [hooks:secrets:delete](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/hooks-secrets-delete): Delete one hook secret.
- [hooks:secrets:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/hooks-secrets-list): List hook secret metadata for an owner node.
- [hooks:secrets:update](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/hooks-secrets-update): Rotate one hook secret value.
- [hooks:set-enabled](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/hooks-set-enabled): Enable or disable an existing hook.
- [hooks:update](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/hooks-update): Update mutable hook fields for an existing hook.
- [import:subgraph](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/import-subgraph): Import graph JSON into new node records.
- [CLI Reference](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli): Command reference generated from the Flywheel Usage spec.
- [integrations:huggingface:remove](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/integrations-huggingface-remove): Remove your Hugging Face credential.
- [integrations:huggingface:set](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/integrations-huggingface-set): Store a Hugging Face access token.
- [integrations:status](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/integrations-status): Check integration connection status (W&B, Hugging Face).
- [integrations:wandb:remove](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/integrations-wandb-remove): Remove your W&B credential.
- [integrations:wandb:set](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/integrations-wandb-set): Store a Weights & Biases API key.
- [machines:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/machines-list): List your managed compute leases.
- [nodes:add-parent](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-add-parent): Add a parent-child edge (mirrors POST /nodes/{node_id}/parents/add).
- [nodes:branch](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-branch): Create a child branch from a node.
- [nodes:children](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-children): Page direct visible children for one node.
- [nodes:commit-new](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-commit-new): Create and commit a new node in one request.
- [nodes:commit](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-commit): Commit staged changes to an existing node.
- [nodes:create](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-create): Create a minimal node (title only) and emit graph-change event.
- [nodes:delete-bulk](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-delete-bulk): Delete multiple node subtrees. Requires --yes.
- [nodes:delete](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-delete): Delete a node by identifier. Requires --yes.
- [nodes:files](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-files): List files attached to a node.
- [nodes:get](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-get): Fetch one node by identifier. Use relationship paging commands for complete direct-neighbor traversal.
- [nodes:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-list): List nodes with optional filters.
- [nodes:merge](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-merge): Merge multiple nodes into one resolved node.
- [nodes:parents](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-parents): Page direct visible parents for one node.
- [nodes:remove-parent](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-remove-parent): Remove a parent-child edge.
- [nodes:render:ancestry](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-render-ancestry): Render ancestry (roots-ward lineage) for a node.
- [nodes:render:summary](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-render-summary): Render a compact summary of a node subtree.
- [nodes:render:tree](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-render-tree): Render a bounded tree projection for a node.
- [nodes:resolve-slug](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-resolve-slug): Resolve a slug to a node ID.
- [nodes:sharing:get](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-sharing-get): Get sharing (access policy) for a node.
- [nodes:sharing:set-bulk](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-sharing-set-bulk): Apply one sharing policy to multiple nodes.
- [nodes:sharing:set](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-sharing-set): Replace sharing (access policy) for a node.
- [nodes:sharing:summaries](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-sharing-summaries): Read access summaries for multiple nodes in one batch.
- [nodes:stage:lease:acquire](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-stage-lease-acquire): Acquire an edit lease for an existing node.
- [nodes:stage:lease:heartbeat](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-stage-lease-heartbeat): Heartbeat an active node stage lease.
- [nodes:stage:lease:release](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/nodes-stage-lease-release): Release a node stage lease.
- [profile:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/profile-list): List configured CLI profiles (local only).
- [profile:set](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/profile-set): Create or update a CLI profile (local only; never stores plaintext keys).
- [profile:show](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/profile-show): Show a profile definition (local only).
- [profile:unset](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/profile-unset): Delete a CLI profile (local only).
- [remote-artifacts:refresh](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/remote-artifacts-refresh): Force refresh a public HTTPS JSON Remote Artifact for a node.
- [remote-artifacts:resolve](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/remote-artifacts-resolve): Resolve a public HTTPS JSON Remote Artifact for a node.
- [setup](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/setup): Set up Flywheel for your AI coding host
- [tags:assign](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/tags-assign): Assign or clear tags on a node (atomic replace).
- [tags:create](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/tags-create): Create a reusable tag on a graph root.
- [tags:delete](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/tags-delete): Delete a tag definition from the graph.
- [tags:update](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/tags-update): Update a tag definition.
- [uninstall](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/uninstall): Remove Flywheel MCP entries and bundled skills from selected hosts
- [update](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/update): Update the local Flywheel CLI package and setup artifacts
- [updates:hide-all-active](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/updates-hide-all-active): Hide all currently active announcements.
- [updates:hide](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/updates-hide): Hide a specific announcement.
- [updates:list](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/updates-list): List in-app announcements relevant to your account.
- [updates:unhide](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/updates-unhide): Restore a previously hidden announcement.
- [version](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/cli/version): Print the Flywheel CLI version.
- [Encoding the Scientific Method](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/how-to-use-flywheel/encoding-the-scientific-method): Use Flywheel nodes as evidence-backed hypotheses, claims, and conclusions.
- [MCP](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/mcp): Use Flywheel from compatible agent hosts through the Model Context Protocol.
- [MCP Setup](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/mcp/setup): Configure a compatible host to call Flywheel MCP tools.
- [MCP Tools](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/mcp/tools): Overview of Flywheel MCP tool families.
- [MCP Troubleshooting](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/mcp/troubleshooting): Common MCP setup checks.
- [Get Blob](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/api/blobs/get_blob_v1_blobs__key__get): Download a blob by key, if it belongs to the current user.
- [Auth Status](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/api/api/auth_status_v1_auth_status_get): Check authentication and session-capacity status.
- [Claim Referral Code](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/api/credits/claim_referral_code_v1_credits_referral_claim_post): Claim referral rewards for inviter and invitee.
- [Get Credits](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/api/credits/get_credits_v1_credits_get): Get the current user's credit balance.
- [Get Referral Overview](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/api/credits/get_referral_overview_v1_credits_referral_get): Get referral code and current referral-beta stats for this user.
- [Get Subscription Status](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/api/credits/get_subscription_status_v1_credits_subscription_get): Get subscription status for the authenticated user.
- [Get Transactions](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/api/credits/get_transactions_v1_credits_transactions_get): Get the user's credit transaction history.
- [Get Usage](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/api/credits/get_usage_v1_credits_usage_get): Get the current user's API usage breakdown. Returns usage aggregated by feature (assistant, engineer) for the specified time period.
- [Create Feedback](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/api/feedback/create_feedback_v1_feedback_post): Flywheel public documentation page.
- [Approve Mcp Api Key Setup Device](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/api/mcp-api-keys/approve_mcp_api_key_setup_device_v1_auth_mcp_api_keys_setup_device_approve_post): Flywheel public documentation page.
- [Delete Mcp Api Key](https://docs.flywheel.paradigma.inc/api/mcp-api-keys/delete_mcp_api_key_v1_auth_mcp_api_keys__key_id__delete): Flywheel public documentation page.
